name: Women Behind Bars
overview:
Based on global data, the number of male offenders worldwide has increased by 22% since 2000, while the number of female offenders has surged by 60%. This alarming trend raises pressing questions about the underlying causes behind the rapid rise in female incarceration.

This five-part documentary series delves into the daily lives and psychological transformations of women inside prison. Through intimate observation and in-depth storytelling, it explores the social, emotional, and personal factors that lead women to crime, as well as how they navigate rehabilitation systems and institutional correction.

By examining female inmates’ lived environments, inner struggles, and paths toward redemption, the series reflects on broader themes of justice, punishment, gender, and social responsibility. Women’s Prison offers a rare and powerful perspective on crime and correction, encouraging audiences to reconsider society’s approach to incarceration and rehabilitation.
